name: Customizable Hose Adapter (pool hose, garden hose)

captions.detailed: This 3D model is a parametric hose-to-hose adapter designed to join two flexible hoses. It features a cylindrical body with a hollow interior channel running through its length. Both ends have ribbed, barbed profiles consisting of three stacked conical rings to grip the inside of a hose and prevent slipping. The overall shape tapers slightly in the middle where the two main cylindrical sections of differing diameters meet.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric hose adapter in OpenSCAD that connects two hoses of different diameters. The script should allow the user to adjust the overall length, the middle radius, and the wall thickness, automatically generating barbed rings at both ends to securely grip the hoses.
captions.factory: The script uses a difference() operation to hollow out a union() of several cylinders. The outer shape is formed by joining two primary cylinders representing the lower and upper halves, with a slight overlap. Three smaller, tapered cylinders are translated and added to both the lower and upper ends to form the barbed grip rings. Finally, two internal cylinders with radii reduced by the wall thickness parameter are subtracted to create the hollow inner flow path.
